issues.title: Engine-oil-cooler union leakage and source-copied future VIN torque cutover
issues.cause: Two independently year-indexed factory procedures each print oil-pipe coupling torque as 10 Nm before VIN suffix 73514908 and 8 Nm from the boundary.
symptoms: oil seep at front oil cooler connection
cooler hose joint serviced without O-ring check
issues.diagnosis_summary: Distinguish engine-oil-cooler hose/O-ring from automatic-transmission radiator cooler and check oil leakage and actual vehicle VIN/build/hardware. Use cold and supported vehicle conditions.
issues.correction_summary: Apply verified WIS oil-cooler joint instructions, inspect/replace O-rings as appropriate, fill cooler with proper oil and retest leaks.
limits: MY2006 directory carrying 7-prefixed VIN cutover does not establish a 2006 model-year design change.
No original OEM part-number supersession or official replacement approved.
A specification is not evidence of a car's actual oil pressure or failure risk.

issues.title: Mirrored model-year left-mount page may imply a false 2005 hardware change
issues.cause: Both 2005 and 2007 source pages reproduce the same 73514478/73514479 cutover, indicating cross-year carried service instructions.
symptoms: mechanic assumes mount bolt changed in MY2005
part suggested from WIS directory year rather than original VIN
issues.diagnosis_summary: Match actual stamped VIN, installed engine and transmission, mount variant and exact bolted joint; check original Saab EPC/build data.
issues.correction_summary: Use the source's cutover literally only when vehicle identification supports it; no year-only part interchange.
limits: No evidence from WIS year path that this part or torque changed during 2005.
Torque split alone is not a manufacturer supersession chain.
Do not support powertrain unsafely to perform an inspection.

issues.title: Coolant deterioration or incorrect mixture may compromise corrosion protection
issues.cause: 2007/2008 WIS specifies coolant-change maximum 3 years; 2009 service requires freeze/corrosion protection and warns against mixing different coolant types.
symptoms: weak freeze protection in cold climate
issues.diagnosis_summary: Inspect service records, mixture and freeze point with appropriate tool; identify leak source and correct original approved coolant type, not solely colour.
issues.correction_summary: Service with vehicle-approved compatible coolant and correct mixture/bleeding procedure, replace leaking components only after verifying failure.
limits: Do not translate a 7.4 L nominal capacity into a mandatory partial-drain fill quantity.
2009 original Saab fluid naming is not confirmation of a 2026 equivalent.
Coolant service cannot repair rusted rear subframes or prove powertrain life.
